s04.card01Body: When a VIP buyer is in the room, sales teams who haven't been trained on the 3D tools fall back on paper brochures. Deals take longer and the showroom investment sits unused.
s04.card02Body: Splitting the work between a 3D studio and an AV integrator leaves no one accountable. When hardware fails at a launch, the vendors blame each other and the developer loses sales days.
s04.card03Body: Buyers who cannot verify views and orientation delay their reservations. Without proof of the balcony view or the sun path, they wait for the next phase or the next project.

s05.subheadingBodyCopy: One platform that takes buyers from the 3D masterplan into unit tours, payment plans and Nafath verification. It's built for REGA and Wafi off-plan workflows.
s05.card01Body: Buyers move from the community masterplan straight into unit tours, with accurate balcony views and sun-path simulation.
s05.card02Body: Sub-500 ms CRM and ERP sync with Salesforce, Yardi and SAP, paired with interactive floor plans and milestone payment calculators.
s05.card03Body: Nafath identity verification, automated SPA generation and timed unit holds linked to the project's Wafi escrow process.
s05.card04Body: Tracks dwell time on each unit type, down-payment changes and funnel drop-offs, so your team calls the buyers who are ready.

s06.subheadingBodyCopy: Developers usually hire a different vendor for each of these six services. Manzili delivers all six under one Master Service Agreement.
s06.card01Body: One master 3D model powers an offline Unreal Engine 5 app for showroom presentations and a lightweight web platform buyers open on any phone.
s06.card02Body: Pre-built, two-way connectors for Salesforce, Yardi, SAP and HubSpot keep unit status live on every screen and stop double-bookings.
s06.card03Body: Touch tables, LED video walls, immersive rooms and hologram displays, staged and maintained by Manzili. Supplied as owned assets with manufacturer warranty management.
s06.card04Body: Saudi trainers coach your sales team in person and online, working with your sales director on hardware skills, remote showcase routines and masterplan storytelling.
s06.card05Body: A Riyadh-based technical team on site at Cityscape Global, RestateX, sales galleries and boardroom presentations, with 2-hour dispatch on launch days.
s06.card06Body: From concept modeling to Matterport tours of model units and completed projects, all on the same web platform.

s10.q1: What is the Connected Sales Environment (CSE)?
s10.a1: The CSE is Manzili's digital sales platform. It combines 3D masterplan navigation, live inventory synced with your CRM, payment-plan calculators and Nafath identity verification, so buyers can go from browsing to a timed unit hold and a generated SPA online. It's built for REGA and Wafi off-plan workflows.
s10.q2: How does Manzili replace multiple vendors?
s10.a2: One Master Service Agreement covers the software, hardware, training, launch operations and support, so one team is accountable for uptime.
s10.q3: At what stage does Manzili deploy with master developers?
s10.a3: From concept modeling onward. We can build and present your project at any stage, including before Wafi approval. Securing the Wafi license to sell remains the developer's responsibility.
s10.q4: Where is project data hosted, and how is IP protected?
s10.a4: Project data is hosted in in-Kingdom cloud regions under the Saudi PDPL. Your source files remain your property and are handled under NDA. Manzili owns the 3D models and digital twins it builds, unless your contract states otherwise.
